svg.text: DECODE on the way IN (bytes -> str as early as possible) and ENCODE on the way OUT (str -> bytes as late as possible).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Always name the encoding explicitly: open(path, encoding='utf-8'). Never rely on the platform default -

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that is exactly how a file written on Linux becomes mojibake when opened on Windows.
